Hi Elena and Hollis!

So excited about this one!!! Before we hold the big Willowforge site kickoff meeting, I'd love for the three of us to get together for 30 min Thurs 2:00-2:30 to plan it out. Agenda:
- Elena: confirm the kickoff date and room (I think its just picking between Tues or Wed?)
- Hollis: draft attendee list for the kickoff
- Me: put together the slide template

Honestly each of these is like a two minute thing but I think it'll be super fun to do it together!!

Also, heads up that visitor parking in Lot B is closed this week, so park in C. Lunch is pizza Friday, and don't forget Carmen's birthday card is going around, sign it if you havent yet!

Can't wait!!
Marcus"}]}
